note: Rewritten from Rosen (1912) original description; the original is in German and describes the soldier only. It was published as a variety (var. transiens) and is treated here as a separate species following BSF; the original gives only one diagnostic character for this variety, the toothless mandibles, and two measurements, so the entry is correspondingly short.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Comes from the same nest as the typical form of Microcerotermes liederi. It differs in the toothless mandibles. In this it approaches Microcerotermes edentatus, but that species has a paler and narrower head. Measurements: head length including mandibles 3.1 mm, head width 1.1 mm.
